data.name: MiniLM with PCA reconstruction
data.research_question: Can linear subspace reconstruction of frozen MiniLM embeddings identify unusual events?
data.hypothesis: PCA reconstruction will capture dominant benign variation but miss nonlinear anomalies.
data.training_strategy: Fit PCA on benign training embeddings only.

evaluation_configuration.threshold: 99th percentile of benign validation reconstruction error

data.results_summary: ROC-AUC 0.954165 and Average Precision 0.007092. All 70 original positives were detected with 10,778 false positives at P99.
data.interpretation: Semantic embeddings improve ranking over lexical baselines, but linear compression produces a weak anomaly score and low precision.
data.limitations: PCA is a linear method and its 32 components explain most benign variance, including possibly some attack signal.
